priority: 1. Cookie tapcopy-lang (en|es, Max-Age 31536000, Path=/, SameSite=Lax, Secure) — set ONLY by the manual switcher
2. CF-IPCountry in [MX, AR, BO, CL, CO, CR, CU, DO, EC, SV, GQ, GT, HN, NI, PA, PY, PE, PR, ES, UY, VE] → /es/
3. Accept-Language whose highest-q language is es* → /es/
geo_language_routing.redirect: 302 + Cache-Control: private, no-store; query string preserved
geo_language_routing.vary_header: CF-IPCountry, Cookie, Accept-Language (Accept-Language added because it is part of the decision)
geo_language_routing.bots: Never redirected (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, social previews, SEO crawlers, missing UA)
geo_language_routing.deep_links: A visitor without cookie who opens /es/ directly stays there; only cookie=en moves them out
geo_language_routing.assets_and_api: bypass middleware (any path with file extension, /api/*)
